mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which impairs atazanavir absorption and increases cardiovascular/arrhythmia risk; atazanavir may inhibit amphotericin B metabolism, increasing toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac parameters closely; consider alternative antifungal agents (fluconazole, azoles) if possible; ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation; monitor for atazanavir efficacy due to absorption changes.
